Hi Sofia / Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick turnaround on the agenda. Before we book the live POC walkthrough with our clinical team, procurement has asked that we complete our vendor onboarding checklist (portal invite), an executed NDA, and a short security questionnaire. I know the POC was intended for next week, but two things are blocking us:

- Our Head of Clinical Ops (Ajay) is traveling May 24–28 and wants to be present for the initial session.
- Procurement needs the vendor portal link and the questionnaire completed so they can run the intake against our policies.

Could we pause scheduling until the portal invite and NDA are circulated? Procurement said they will aim to send the questionnaire and DocuSign NDA by EOD Monday.

If helpful, we can propose a new window the week of June 21 when Ajay is back and exec calendars look lighter.

Appreciate your flexibility — Priya
